# Vendored files

`anonymize_test_resources.py` is an unmodified copy of `scripts/anonymize-test-resources.py` from
[udondan/amazon-orders](https://github.com/udondan/amazon-orders) at commit
`1c0f31f1a48f4aa59333ff904e815a3046579ffc` (MIT, Copyright (c) 2024-2026 Alex Laird).

It is not part of the installed package, so it is copied here and extended by `scripts/anonymize_fixtures.py`.
Keep it unmodified, so it can be replaced by a newer upstream version.
